assertions.text: Invokes Skill(create-pr) exactly once, passing an instruction to include `Closes #123` in the drafted PR body
States the call is one-way (create-pr never invokes collaborating-on-a-pr back) and passes no skip or loop-breaking instruction
After create-pr returns, verifies the line with `gh pr view --json body -q .body` rather than assuming create-pr honored the instruction
Never describes creating a second PR or invoking create-pr a second time
